channel.title: Music Business Worldwide (MBW) - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Music Business Worldwide (MBW) (musicbusinessworldwide.com)

item.title: Spotify eyes AI ‘derivatives’ as new revenue stream for artists – says its tech to let fans make remixes and covers is ready
item.description: Spotify says it wants to enable listeners to interact with their favorite artists' music through AI Source

item.title: Roslyn Pineda appointed President, Asia for Sony Music Publishing, as Carol Ng retires
item.description: Pineda succeeds longtime SMP Asia President, Carol Ng, who will remain with the company until her planned retirement at the end of March this year. Source

item.title: Warner partners with UK-based music development organization Generator to ‘power new creative opportunities’ in North of England
item.description: Three-year agreement aims to improve long-term industry access and career pathways for talent in the north of England Source

item.title: Music tech startup Mozart AI raises $6M in seed round led by Balderton Capital
item.description: The startup offers a Generative Audio Workstation (GAW) for both amateur musicians and seasoned producers. Source

item.title: Jody Farber promoted to CFO of Peermusic, as Bill Gorjance retires after 20 years
item.description: Gorjance will serve as International Vice President of the Classical music division in a part-time role. Source

item.title: SoundExchange expands global neighboring rights coverage via 17 new agreements with CMOs in markets including Barbados, Denmark, Kenya, Portugal, and more
item.description: The expansion includes new partnerships in Kenya, Barbados, Panama, Paraguay, and several European territories. Source

item.title: Mitchell Shymansky appointed Chief Data & Technology Officer at Create Music Group
item.description: Shymansky joins Create following nearly two decades at Universal Music Group Source

item.title: SM Entertainment revenues grew 16.6% to record $219m in Q4, driven by concerts and merch
item.description: The company is home to K-pop acts such as NCT DREAM, aespa, RIIZE, and NCT WISH. Source

item.title: Music collectibles platform Wax Poetics closes $1m funding round
item.description: Investors include music executives Perry Chen (Kickstarter), Nadav Poraz (WhoSampled), and Nikhil Shah (Mixcloud). Source

item.title: Olivier Chastan’s Iconoclast in sale talks at price tag of around $500 million
item.description: Multiple sources tell MBW that Iconoclast is in talks with approximately 10 different parties Source
